correctness.rationale: Direct Fourier expansion gives cχ(u*v)=cχ^-1(u)cχ²(v). Active orbit idempotent equations force c_{χ^{-1}}=1/c_χ and c_{χ^2}=c_χ^2, with odd local order N=2^(d/2)+1 or 2^d−1. Thus nonzero coordinate multiplication z*w=z^-1 w² and inactive coordinates absorb. Supports intersect; fixed supports are connected Latin quandles because 2 is invertible. Right-translation surjectivity forces any subquandle to have constant support. Left/right ideal closure yields every lower support fiber via solving 2v−u=w, so ideals correspond exactly to Boolean downsets. Independently enumerated abstract two-coordinate magma ideals (five each) and inspected direct finite-field checker; all-group assertion rests on the Fourier proof.

value.rationale: The complete ideal lattice and maximal connected subquandle decomposition give a natural algebraic classification of the finite idempotent magma. These structures matter for homomorphisms, submagma ideals and quandle stratification and are not supplied by a count of isolated idempotents or a vector-space ideal lattice.

final_claim: For every finite odd-order abelian G, idempotents in C[Core(G)] form a product of zero-adjoined cyclic core quandles and meet {0,1}; maximal quandle strata are fixed-support fibers and nonempty two-sided magma ideals correspond bijectively to nonempty Boolean downsets.
limitations: Complex coefficients and odd-order abelian cores only; ideals are nonempty two-sided subsets of idempotents, NOT linear ideals of ambient algebra. Finite enumeration is corroboration.
